def facts():
    (p,) = [L.plan(a) for a in asts(T(CH).sum((0, 2, 3)))]
    split = R._split_reduction(p)
    leaf = R._leaf_reduce(split)
    sub, outside, clusters = R._leaf(split, leaf)
    return {
        "leaf": [U.extent(r) for r in split.reductions[id(leaf)]],
        "outside": [U.extent(r) for r in outside],
        "temporary": list(sub.out_shape),
        "clusters": clusters,
    }
